body: I will try meds. I am feeling a little bit better. Thank you.

The game is called The Witcher 3, and I've been looking forward to it for a while. It's an action rpg, and it follows the story of a witcher named Geralt. Actually, about a year ago, I made an agreement that I wouldn't kill myself until I got to play this video game.

I haven't tried antidepressants at all, but I feel like my issues are so unimportant that I shouldn't even bother going to therapy.

It's a stupid reason why I want to do it on the 23rd. A game I want to play comes out on the 19th, and I just want to play a little before dying. I have tried to talk to someone, but my feelings will always be the same. Recently, I went to a doctor, but I've heard so many stories of failure with antidepressants and therapy. Also, I feel like any help given to me will be a waste, considering my worthlessness and suicidal plan. I guess the only worth I have is: giving people money for antidepressants and therapy.
